text:
ryan_csm: Heads-up — AstraNova QBR scheduled next Wed 10am PT. Need token econ snapshot, onboarding health, and renewal risk flags. Who can own spend forecast + recommended mitigations?

maria_cs: I can own the forecast. Will pull 30/60/90 day usage and do a baseline vs projected trend.

devon_se: I noticed their embedding ratio jumped last week after the new feature release. Need to see top routes and cache keys. Can someone dump route counts?

ops_bot: alert: account=astranova presence: embedding_calls_peak=2.1M tokens/day @ 2026-03-18 03:21 UTC — throttle policy applied (dedicated-burst).

ashley_re: Renewal at risk unless we show clear cost reduction plan + enablement. They used free credits then spiked, so finance is nervous.

sara_finops: Quick note — their current invoice projection (w/o changes) = $4.8k / month (hosted pricing). If they convert to a small dedicated commitment we can cap ~ $3.6k/mo but requires 3mo commit.

maria_cs: Draft numbers: current monthly burn ≈ 6.5M tokens; MoM +35%. With prefix caching + batching + dedupe we estimate net -28% tokens. With quantized model variant for rerank routes another -12% on inference cost.

devon_se: Re: routes — here's the quick query I ran for top endpoints:```sql
SELECT route, sum(tokens) as tokens, count(*) as calls
FROM usage
WHERE account = 'astranova' AND time >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

maria_cs: Sharing a short playbook I want in the QBR: 1) Immediate: enable prefix KV cache for chat/history routes; 2) 2-week: enable batching with 200ms window for bulk embed jobs; 3) 30-day: propose small Dedicated commit + eval of quantized model variant; 4) Enable budget alerts and soft throttle thresholds.

ashley_re: Can we get a one-pager mapping these to customer success asks for the meeting? I can present renewal ask + demo of cost model.

sara_finops: I'll prepare a spend sensitivity table. Need two scenarios: "status quo" and "with optimizations". Also show credit runway if they keep current free credits vs commit.

devon_se: Small config snippet for caching to include in the one-pager:```yaml
routes:
  - name: /chat/complete
    cache: prefix_kv
    cache_ttl: 3600
    batching:
      enabled: true
      max_delay_ms: 200
```

ops_bot: note: a temporary alert will be created for astranova when daily tokens > 1.5M for 3 consecutive days. Tagging #cs-escalations.

maria_cs: Action items: (1) I will post forecast + sensitivity by EOD tomorrow; (2) @devon_se please add top-10 route list and expected savings by optimization; (3) @sara_finops prepare two-scenario table; (4) @ashley_re draft renewal ask + commitment options.

ashley_re: acked. I'll include a recommended mitigation discount ladder tied to commit levels.

devon_se: will add expected ops impact (latency delta and risk) — want to be transparent.

sara_finops: I'll also add a calendar invite for a 30-min pre-QBR dry run Tue morning.

ryan_csm: Perfect — if we can surface a concrete ~$ savings number and a clear enablement plan, we should flip this from a risk to an opportunity. Thx all :thumbsup:

maria_cs: will ping with the doc link when ready. :spiral_calendar:

ops_bot: deploy-bot: scheduled runbook scan complete — no config drift detected for astranova private routes.

ashley_re: small ask — can we include a customer quote about value? Even a short usage story helps the execs. I'll reach out to their PM.

ryan_csm: Great. Last note: include the budget alert screenshot and a proposed A/B rollout plan for caching so we can show measurable guardrails in the QBR.

maria_cs: on it.

(ends)"
